description: This file defines an Android Fragment class named ImageDetailFragment that displays an image from a URL, shows a loading indicator, and handles image loading callbacks. It is part of a sample app demonstrating bitmap display and loading.

classes.name: ImageDetailFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that loads and displays an image from a URL, manages loading state with a ProgressBar, and handles image loading callbacks.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of ImageDetailFragment with the specified image URL.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, retrieves the image URL from arguments.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, locates ImageView and ProgressBar UI elements.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets up the image loader, initiates asynchronous image loading, and assigns click listener if applicable.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing image work and clears the ImageView.

methods.name: onImageLoaded
methods.description: Callback indicating image load success, hides the ProgressBar.
